The proper advice is go see a psych, the taboo advice is go to your local pharmacy and ask a pharmacist if any of the vitamins/meds/drugs you're taking would interact with St. John's Wort. People used to take it for depression but it interacts with just about everything under the sun because it alters CYP450 expression in your body. It's not a happy pill, but it takes the edge off of depression. Meanwhile, try to get more sun and take up a hobby with real human interaction. 20+ minutes a day of aerobics also does quite a decent job at providing some extra dopamine and has been shown to be somewhat similar to Rx anti-depressants.
